scope: Catalog component pages, pinned fixture inputs; sampled browser comparison supplements full-frame parity/<slug>.json.

profiles.remocn-video: Live iframe, autoplay and page/request errors checked. Three frames at floor(durationInFrames * p), p = 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, compared with pinned reference MP4 frames. Canonical fixture dimensions, website scale/filter removed, fixture background applied. Shader Color Panels uses hardware WebGL.
profiles.remocn-icon-video: Live iframe with pinned 384px showcase size explicitly applied. Autoplay and page/request errors checked. Canonical showcase dimensions, white background, website scale/filter removed. Three frames compared with pinned reference MP4 frames.
profiles.remocn-same-browser-png: Remocn live iframe checks plus three PNG comparisons against pinned upstream rendered in the same browser, avoiding differences between browser/GPU shader implementations.
profiles.snapcn-png: Live iframe autoplay, pause, replay, images, media readiness and page/console/HTTP/request errors checked. Three pinned upstream lossless PNG frames at floor((durationInFrames - 1) * p), p = 0.2, 0.5, 0.8. Seek (frame + 0.1) / fps avoids previous-video-frame rounding. Canonical dimensions after controls checked at website size; reference alpha composited over the iframe background.
profiles.rendered-defaults: Ordinary Chrome lacks the required HTML-in-canvas API. Verified HyperFrames default render played in the catalog video element; autoplay, pause, replay and default-settings notice checked. No live customization or new browser SSIM claim.
profiles.remocn-lossless-png: Five additions at e3dc260ff1965440d1f64fb65a8c9a9373e78328. Actual catalog iframe autoplay, Pause, Replay, customizer edits and Reset checked at website size. Customizations change pixels; Reset restores identical pixels. Three canonical-size samples at floor(durationInFrames * p), p = 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, compared with pinned lossless reference PNGs using NVIDIA ANGLE gl-egl, sRGB and source font-render-hinting flags. Reference alpha is composited over the fixture background; website scaling and controls are removed for comparison. Both transitions additionally compare eight boundary seeks, seven backwards. Navigation-cancelled requests and local Vercel telemetry 404s are recorded separately from component failures.
profiles.remocn-template-png: Five templates at 7fa2db1cd29dfb36743e54e3d078dd9107c879a2, checked September 12. Actual catalog iframe autoplay, Pause, Replay, accent color edits and Reset at website size. Edits change pixels; Reset restores identical pixels. Three canonical-size samples at 20%, 50%, and 80% plus final/middle/first frame seeks compared with pinned lossless reference PNGs. Native timeline seeks use the authored fps. NVIDIA ANGLE gl-egl, sRGB and source font-render-hinting flags; reference alpha composited over the fixture background. Navigation-cancelled requests and local Vercel telemetry 404s recorded separately.
profiles.remocn-icon-png: Inbox: native 384px source props and canvas, render scale 1, pinned lossless PNGs. Actual catalog iframe with size=384 and canonical geometry; all 70 frames and three repeated backward seeks verified.

limitations: Only listed checks were performed; omitted fields mean unmeasured, not zero.
Three sampled browser frames do not replace the full-frame deterministic render checks in parity/<slug>.json.
Reference formats and normalization differ by profile, so the aggregate mean is descriptive only.
icon-inbox has one browser sample below 0.95. Its separately verified 384px showcase full-frame mean is 0.970517; its minimum is 0.811321. The 48px installed fixture mean is 0.994187.
Rendered fallback checks cover the default video and controls, not customized live rendering.

The five e3dc260 browser checks ran on a local production preview server. Vercel analytics and speed-insights endpoints returned 404 because the local server does not provide those routes; these are recorded separately from component HTTP and console errors.
